exposure: Interval between wheezing episodes (within 1 year vs. 1-3 years)
cohort: Children (n=427) from a previous study, specifically those (n=62) who had at least two wheezing episodes and met one major or two minor criteria of the Asthma Predictive Index (API).
finding: The study suggests that children with frequent wheezing episodes with longer intervals (up to 3 years) should be considered for asthma diagnosis when applying the API to retrospective medical records.
